That `checksum` function was already unused before my change (unrelated dead code) — leaving it alone. All 4 existing tests pass with the new FIFO-by-write-time eviction logic in `src/store.rs`.

Summary of the change:
- Renamed the tracked timestamp from `used` to `written`, and it's now only set when a key is newly inserted — never touched by `get`, and never updated when overwriting an existing key's value.
- Eviction (`evict_oldest_write`) now picks the entry with the smallest `written` timestamp, i.e., the one written longest ago, regardless of read history.
